verdict.rationale: Statsig's MCP server lets AI clients like Claude Code or Cursor query experiment/gate data and 'ask questions' of the data, and AI Evals features support prompt/model experimentation, but there's no evidence of native in-product AI-generated insights, anomaly detection, or automated suggestions surfaced within the Statsig console itself. missing for 10: in-console AI-generated insight summaries/suggestions, automated anomaly/root-cause detection, evidence of natural-language querying inside the product UI (not just via external MCP client).
